title: Machine learning-based transcriptome analysis of lipid metabolism biomarkers for the survival prediction in hepatocellular carcinoma
summary: The signature is evaluated across transcriptomic cohorts for survival association. The result is retrospective and observational; it does not establish causal biology or treatment benefit.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis of lipid-metabolism transcripts identifies hepatocellular-carcinoma subtypes and a survival-associated signature.
